purpose: Extract the source-defined representation-mixing index structure of the q-EPRL braiding law without using any RC006 holdout sign or desired contraction order.
independence_lock: No historical RC006 holdout outcomes, S_CROSS, serialization order, Eq29 desired answer, or amplitude value may be used to select or simplify the source structure.
frozen_required_objects: braiding action is expressed with an explicit sum over at least one intermediate representation label K
the transformed object contains source-defined representation labels/functions depending on the summed K
a nontrivial coefficient/kernel multiplies the transformed q-EPRL object
the output representation data are not merely a permutation of the input labels
free versus summed indices can be distinguished from the source expression
acceptance: Both independent lanes must recover the same qualitative index graph: summed representation label(s), transformed representation label dependence, and nontrivial coefficient/kernel. If either lane cannot distinguish free/summed structure, fail closed as PARTIAL.
downstream_if_pass: A separate source-to-RC006 namespace/incidence mapping preregistration is authorized. No sign-only mapping is authorized.
